reviews.review:
If you like nonograms, this is the mother of all nonogram games. A ton of different varieties of puzzles, a ton of different puzzles, and an EXTREMELY in-depth and nice nonogram maker program. Seriously, that nonogram maker is an absolute delight - it's easy to use, simple to understand, and has all the functionality you'd ever want. Plus, the game runs really well on Steam Deck, including the nonogram maker.

I experienced a few minor bugs, like initially when loading the daily puzzle the UI borked and I couldn't do anything, and the first workshop puzzle I downloaded was "empty" until I reloaded the game, but those are sincerely so minor for an Early Access day one playthrough that I'd barely count them. The actual gameplay itself is flawless and awesome, like most of this dev's works.

Worth your money to buy the DLCs! They are cheap!
